title: SemiCurv: Semi-Supervised Curvilinear Structure Segmentation
mechanism: Curvilinear SSL with geometric strong augmentation, using a differentiable inverse transform to align predictions for pixel-wise consistency. An N-pair consistency loss prevents collapse to background on imbalanced thin structures.
adaptation: Apply its N-pair consistency to crack logits on pool cells, combined with the geometric transform plus inverse warp, instead of CE on hard pseudo-labels. Usable as the unlabelled loss in the ensemble-distillation or UniMatch V2 arms.
min_experiment: Ensemble-distillation arm B with an N-pair consistency term vs without. Metric: crack relF1@2 clean 49 and E1. Kill: < +0.005 relF1@2.
evidence: R: 6 curvilinear datasets including cracks; with at most 5% labels, reaches about 95% of fully supervised performance.
prior_overlap: Partial. Mean Teacher consistency with CutMix was run (n.d. at 100%). The N-pair loss and geometric inverse-warp consistency were not.
